email.subject: POAP KINGS is recruiting — a Clash Royale clan that actually tracks its history
email.body:
We're POAP KINGS, a 42-member Clash Royale clan built around war performance, real recognition, and clan culture that sticks around longer than a season.

Our top players are sitting at 13,000+ trophies, and our clan donates 4,000 cards a week. We take Clan Wars seriously — battle days mean using your decks, and we track who shows up.

What makes us different: we issue POAPs (Proof of Attendance Protocol tokens) for seasons and milestones, creating a collectible record of your time in the clan. We also run a Free Pass Royale program — the season's top war contributor earns one. It's earned, not handed out.

We're still a young clan, which means the founding era is still happening. There's real room to build something here alongside people who care about it.

Requirement is 3,000 trophies. See who we are at https://poapkings.com.

reddit.title: POAP KINGS (#J2RGCRVG) — War-focused clan, real traditions, 42 members [3000]
reddit.body:
**POAP KINGS** is recruiting. We're a 42-member Clash Royale clan built around Clan Wars, consistent donations, and clan culture that actually means something.

**Quick stats:**
- Clan tag: #J2RGCRVG
- Required trophies: 3,000
- 42/50 members
- 336,000+ combined trophies
- 4,000 card donations this week
- War trophies: 320

**Who we are:**

We were founded by three people — two cousins who've played Clash Royale for years and one of their dads, who liked what they were building and wanted in. That's the kind of clan this is: people who actually know each other, building something worth staying in.

Our top players are at 13,000+ trophies. Our leader, King Thing, leads the clan in donations at 410 this week. War participation is tracked and recognized — the season's top war contributor earns a Free Pass Royale.

**What makes us different:**
- We issue POAPs (Proof of Attendance Protocol tokens) for seasons and milestones. It's a collectible record of your time in the clan that lives outside the game.
- We run Elixir, a custom AI operator that tracks war performance, milestones, and clan history.
- We celebrate real effort — not just trophy count.

**What we want:**

Active players at 3,000+ trophies who show up for war when they can, donate regularly, and want to be part of a clan that's building something. Real life comes first — we're not guilt-trippers. But if you're in, be in.

Learn more or apply at https://poapkings.com
